_about: Core combat numbers from the Combat core spec. Change these to tune; no code changes needed.

flank._about: Flank chance = terrain flank_base + per_mobility x (Mobility - mobility_pivot) + the terrain's band_modifier, limited to clamp.

suppression._about: Suppressed units take -aim_penalty Aim, reduced by 1 for every will_per_point Will above will_threshold.

morale._about: Morale starts at Will. Shaken below shaken_below, Broken (flees) at broken_at or below. Gains stop at Will + cap_over_will.

abilities._about: Innate abilities (Combat core spec, Stat blocks and Morale and psionics). rally_every = side turns between Rallies (2 = every other turn).

recovery._about: When the invaders hold the field, each dead invader has this % chance to be recovered alive and Injured.

withdrawal._about: A side withdraws once it has lost lost_fraction of its starting units and is outnumbered outnumbered_ratio to one.

ai._about: AI decision thresholds (Combat core spec, AI decision rules). flank_counts_fallback_shot: score a failed flank as the plain shot the unit still gets (false = spec wording). cap_damage_at_health: count no damage beyond the target's Health when scoring (false = spec wording).
